title: Green Light for Travis Co. Housing Bonds
summary:
Here's a summary of the November 21, 1991 Austin Housing Finance Corporation Board meeting:

*   The board approved a resolution establishing the framework for the 1991 Travis County Single Family Bond Issue.
*   This significant financial mechanism was authorized to support and finance single-family housing projects throughout Travis County.
*   The measure passed with overwhelming support from the board members.
